# M3TAL Environment Variables Reference

All M3TAL environment variables are managed through the `/etc/m3tal/.env` file. This file is the primary configuration source for both the M3TAL CLI and all Docker Compose stacks, with variables being read via `--env-file` for the stacks and directly by the CLI.

The `m3tal config wizard` command is the recommended way to manage these variables, ensuring correct values and formats.
